chronology: Specified after the original results were examined, before scoring these added contrasts. This is an exploratory extension, not an independent confirmation study.
multiplicity: Holm across all 56 added contrasts for each test engine; within-question Holm is a labelled sensitivity. The original 63-comparison adjustment is retained.
aggregation: average selector subjects within seed, then seeds within held-out subject; no pooling of EEG windows as statistical replicates
inference: Conditional paired subject diagnostics; overlapping source training populations remain a limitation. No equivalence claim from nonsignificance.
prefix_match: all 40 archived model states must match exactly before accepting an 80-unit trajectory
